info.title: UHI Ambulance Booking
info.summary: Send a patient's details to the chosen ambulance provider and get a quote and terms back.
info.description:
**Domain:** `nic2008:86909`
**fulfillment.type:** `EMERGENCY`
**Coverage:** search / on_search and init / on_init. No confirm, status or cancel examples yet.
**Search:** category `ALL`, item `AMBULANCE`, `locations[]` with `SOURCE` and optional `DESTINATION`, `additional_services` tag.
**on_search:** ALS / BLS / PTA / Mortuary Van categories, one fulfillment per vehicle with ETA window, `tracking` flag and `deeplink_url` tag, items with estimated / minimum / maximum charges.
**on_init:** order id, quote breakup (base + consumables), terms in state `INITIATED`, payment `ON-ORDER`.

door.description: Door / Shop number of the address

name.description: Name of address if applicable. Example, shop name

action.description: Defines the DHP API call. Any actions other than the enumerated actions are not supported by DHP Protocol

core_version.description: Version of DHP core API specification being used

consumer_id.description: Unique id of the Consumer. By default it is the fully qualified domain name of the Consumer

consumer_uri.description: URI of the Consumer for accepting callbacks. Must have the same domain name as the consumer_id

provider_id.description: Unique id of the Provider. By default it is the fully qualified domain name of the Provider

transaction_id.description: This is a unique value which persists across all API calls from search through confirm

message_id.description: This is a unique value which persists during a request / callback cycle

timestamp.description: Time of request generation in RFC3339 format

key.description: The encryption public key of the sender

ttl.description: The duration in ISO8601 format after timestamp for which this message holds valid

code.description: Country code as per ISO 3166-1 and ISO 3166-2 format

Descriptor.description: Describes the description of a real-world object.

Domain.description: Describes the domain of an object

Duration.description: Describes duration as per ISO8601 format

code.description: DHP specific error code. For full list of error codes, refer to error_codes.md in the root folder of this repo

path.description: Path to json schema generating the error. Used only during json schema validation errors

message.description: Human readable message describing the error

Fulfillment.description: Describes how a single product/service will be rendered/fulfilled to the end customer

id.description: Unique reference ID to the fulfillment of an order

type.description: This describes the type of fulfillment

tracking.description: Indicates whether the fulfillment allows tracking

start.description: Details on the start of fulfillment

end.description: Details on the end of fulfillment

Image.description:
Image of an object.

A url based image will look like

```uri:http://path/to/image```

Item.description: Describes an item. Allows for domain extension.

id.description: This is the most unique identifier of a service item. An example of an Item ID could be the SKU of a product.

ItemQuantity.description: Describes count or amount of an item

Name.description: Describes the name of a person in format: ./{given_name}/{honorific_prefix}/{first_name}/{middle_name}/{last_name}/{honorific_suffix}

Order.description: Describes the details of an order

id.description: Hash of order object without id

uri.description:
A payment target uri to be called by the DHP-Consumer. Supported formats are

a) https and,

b) payto - Refer to RFC8905

transaction_id.description: This value will be placed in the the $transaction_id url param in case of http/get and in the requestBody http/post requests

type.description: Stage at which the payment is expected

gender.description: Gender of something, typically a Person, but possibly also fictional characters, animals, etc. While Male and Female may be used, text strings are also acceptable for people who do not identify as a binary gender

Price.description: Describes the price of an item. Allows for domain extension.

Provider.description: Describes a service provider. This can be a restaurant, a hospital, a Store etc

exp.description: Time after which catalog has to be refreshed

Scalar.description: An object representing a scalar quantity.

updated_by.description: ID of entity which changed the state

Tags.description: Describes a tag. This is a simple key-value store which is used to contain read-only metadata

Time.description:
Describes time in its various forms. It can be a single point in time; duration; or a structured timetable of operations
UHI currently follows ISO 8601 without timezone format (2022-07-15T00:00:00)

days.description: comma separated values representing days of the week
